description: The headless Svelte 5 table: no <SvGrid> component at all. createSvGrid from @svgrid/grid computes the sorted and filtered rows with rowSortingFeature and columnFilteringFeature, and this component renders a plain hand-styled <table> from them. Click a header to sort, type to filter; the engine owns the logic and you own every element of markup.

faq.question: What does headless mean in SvGrid?
faq.answer: createSvGrid gives you the state and the derived rows (sorted, filtered, grouped, paged) as reactive values, and nothing else. You write the <table>, the headers and the cells yourself and call the engine's setters from your own event handlers.

faq.question: Is the headless engine a separate package?
faq.answer: No. createSvGrid and the feature functions are exported from @svgrid/grid alongside the SvGrid component, so you can start headless and adopt the render component later, or use both in one app.

faq.question: How do I make a header sortable in my own markup?
faq.answer: Give createSvGrid an onSortingChange callback that writes your own sorting state, pass that state back in, and call a small toggle from the header's onclick. The demo does the same for filters with onColumnFiltersChange and an input per column.
